name: Dapple
desc: Sunlight through a canopy falling over the scene — each gap in the leaves is a pinhole, so every pool is a soft-edged image of the sun rather than a shaft, jittering on the breeze and winking shut as a leaf slides across it, with big shadow masses drifting behind; the cheapest way to put any scene outdoors under a tree.

density.doc: number of gaps in the canopy

scale.doc: pool + shadow-mass size vs design size

wind.doc: how far the pools jitter as the branches move

alpha.doc: overlay opacity — additive light is capped, so 1 will not blow the scene out

hue.doc: sun hue (44 midday gold, 20 late afternoon, 205 cold moonlight)

style.doc: aesthetic: soft warm sun pools with penumbra / every pool a partial-eclipse crescent, all facing the same way, as it really goes / isophote contour rings, a topographic map of the light / dot-density stipple engraving instead of soft blobs

act.doc: dramaturgy: gentle shuffle / wind surges with the musical arc and the pools race / the sun sinks over minutes — light reddens and the pools stretch out
